tool_input.command: for f in README.md index.html package.json pigment.app.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/cart/CartContext.tsx src/components/*.tsx src/data/products.ts src/pages/*.tsx src/styles/base.css tests/smoke.spec.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls; cat pigment-snap.mjs | head -50
npm install 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5; npm run typecheck 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 30

(Get-Content src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx -Raw).Replace(' data-rise=""', '') | Set-Content src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx -NoNewline; (Get-Content src/pages/CartPage.tsx -Raw).Replace(' data-rise=""', '') | Set-Content src/pages/CartPage.tsx -NoNewline
